first_pass_desc: Machine called it global motion; actually a dark-blue national-debt web card drops in from the top edge and scales into the upper right while the three figures stay put.

Machine called it regional animation; it starts with a hard cut from the book-reading close-up to a red heart that spins open into two lockets (one reading 'Bond market my beloved'), then a US map character slides in at lower left.
Machine called it a small local change; a low-contrast orange-red UK bond-yield chart fades/pops into the top right.
Machine called it large partial replace; a large light-grey Canadian 30-year bond quote page pops over the left half, covering the blue chart and calendar.

Machine called it global motion; hard cut from the stick figure to an embedded 3D-cartoon clip of a bald bespectacled man by an old TV with caption 'Coincidence?', whose figure then moves within the clip.
Ordinary frame-to-frame motion of the animated man inside the embedded clip; not an editing event.
Small in-clip motion of the glasses-wearing animated man; caption 'Coincidence?' unchanged.
Inside the clip the caption changes to 'I THINK NOT!' and the man lunges into a big close-up, then a hard cut at the end to a stick-figure teacher beside a blank green chalkboard.

Machine called it regional animation; the figure was already hard-cut to a portrait government-debt infographic at about f1291-1294, and this candidate is the infographic sliding left from the right and scaling up into centre.
Machine called it global motion; the infographic scales up about 2.5x and scrolls upward to its bottom bubbles, then a shaggy green Germany-shaped character appears at left.
Machine called it additive; the first speech bubble is replaced by a huge bubble spanning the top reading 'Yeah, me too.' with several tails.

Machine called it global motion; hard cut from logo/paper scene to an embedded cartoon clip (counter with two characters) whose camera pans right to a wall of framed portraits under 'EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH'.
Machine called it global motion; hard cut from the farm scene to blank white, then the burgundy logo card drops in from the top edge to upper-left.
Hard cut from orange-haired stickman holding a wallet (left) to smiling-eyed globe character centre; green dollar money bags then pop in one by one left, then right of globe.

Hard cut at 22117 from smiling stickman to globe with sleepy half-closed eyes flanked by hopping money-bag characters (arms up); bags jitter in place; hard cut at 22158 to frowning stickman. Missed state.
Four-panel chart figure slowly zooms and pans toward its lower-right; a stickman holding a pointer stick enters bottom right in the last frames.
Within the embedded clip the bald figure moves and the graph line shifts; no change to surrounding heading or frame, so not a state boundary.
Heading and film still replaced by one large teal glossy bubble centred (hard cut at 22955 after last clip frames).
Hard cut from stickman at laptop to globe-on-turtle character cropped at left; the turtle then slides rightward into centre over about 1.8 s.
Laptop page keeps scrolling to a new thumbnail row, then hard cut at 23669 to a grinning stickman with hands on hips, centred on white.
Hard cut from SUBSCRIBE! scene to a row of cartoon country maps with sad eyes; a small line chart starts appearing top left.
Hard cut from country maps with five charts to a pair of heart shapes, one holding money, chart and briefcase, the other reading 'Market my beloved'; then slow push-in.
Lone bill document multiplies: dozens of faded and solid copies fade in and pile across the whole frame; then hard cut to a small elderly cane-holding green-tie man at upper left on empty white.
Centred black-haired man replaced by a single large BILL document at lower left; rest empty. Only about 4 frames long before the bill-pile build starts (machine saw it as partial/additive).
One-frame swap: thumbs-up pose becomes deadpan face with arms hanging, while red '20 years' (upper right) and tiny speech text beside the head appear together. Much larger than a micro event.
Green-tie man holding the check appears at lower left with red label under a small black timeline tick and red dot at top left; much larger than a micro event. Start of timeline build.
Bag, check and text replaced by the black-haired stick man at centre with a frown, one arm pointing up-right and the other hand on hip.
Frowning man replaced by the tilted pension check alone at left; right side empty.
A jagged green upward arrow is drawn above the red line, from lower left to upper right, by a pencil tip.
Hard cut to a sky-blue gradient with a grey vehicle edge at top left; a small red-vested stick figure tumbles down, red shouting text beside it, then exits bottom.
Hard cut from empty sky to white canvas with crimson logo card top left; a money bag over the card drifts to lower right, then a green-tie man pops in.
Cartoon at right animates (small crowd figure waves arms) about 1.3 s, then the pair of screenshots is hard-cut to a large pension check with a money bag at lower right.
X-crossed check and bill replaced by black-haired stick man at centre, head turned sideways with flat mouth, body leaning and arm down. Machine saw partial change.
Man replaced by a single green dollar money bag at left on empty white.
Hard cut to a blank-gridded line chart (title, y percentages, x years, source lines), then a thick blue line draws left to right across the chart.
Chart replaced by four bond certificates in a top row, green-tie man holding a check at lower left, a short timeline tick and red label. Machine saw partial change.
Man, dollar sign and bond replaced by a large blue definition card (steering-wheel icon with dollar, title and text) that slides in from the left edge and settles at left-centre.
Card scene replaced by a blue formula graphic above two shouting stick figures (curly brown, blond); held about 2 s, then hard-cut to a dark-skinned bow-tie man with a bond.
